superseding_correction_20260724.reason: The upper and stowed 0x92 snapshots were not captured under a proven continuous, no-power-loss multi-turn counting baseline. The operator powered the system down between the observations. Therefore the two raw values cannot establish total lift travel.
superseding_correction_20260724.conversion_status: The configured 1/14400 mm/native conversion remains a separate protocol/mechanical hypothesis; it must be verified by a measured commanded displacement before becoming a travel calibration.
superseding_correction_20260724.required_remeasurement: Starting at stowed, keep the motor controller powered, record 0x92, move continuously to the upper mechanical endpoint while tracking the counter, record 0x92 again, and independently measure physical millimetres.
